reason: My school is a 20-minute walk, so I don't really need a bike for my daily trip, and with only 10 bikes in the whole town I doubt one would be near me when I'd actually want one. I'd download the app out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay for a monthly plan.
objection: With only 10 bikes, there won't be one near me when I need it, so I can't rely on it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing in the app that there are bikes parked near my place and my school most of the time, so it's actually faster than walking when I'm late.
